**Test Case ID:** TC-NLP-06
**Title:** Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Best Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Best Trucks listing page, open Check Offers, and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Best Trucks listing page
2. Click Check Offers to open its lead form
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
